text:
Kane County enrollment reaches 82,435 students for 2024-25
D. K. Ellis
For the 2024-25 school year, Kane County schools enrolled 82,435 students, according to the Illinois State Board of Education.
This marks a 0.6% increase from the prior school year, which saw 81,968 students attending schools in the county.
Kane County had the state's fifth largest enrollment.
Of all students enrolled, 90.9% were male and 9.1% were female.
Hispanic students represented the largest ethnic group, accounting for about 46.6% of all Kane County students.
East High School reported the highest enrollment in the county during this school year, enrolling 3,942 students.
Statewide, as of the 2024-25 school year, Illinois public schools reported just under 1.85 million K-12 students, extending an ongoing trend of gradual enrollment decline in recent years. For the same period, Illinois recorded a student-teacher ratio close to 17:1, with full-time equivalent teachers rising to a record 137,899.
Illinois K-12 student numbers have seen a drop for several years, reflecting wider demographic patterns. From the 2017-18 through 2024-25 school years, enrollment in Illinois public schools fell from about 2 million to 1.85 million, a decrease of roughly 153,000 students or 7.6%.
